The Intelligent Systems Program at Pitt
The Intelligent Systems Program (ISP) is a multidisciplinary graduate program at the University of Pittsburgh dedicated to applied artificial intelligence (AI).
Quick Links
About

Academics
The Intelligent Systems Program (ISP) offers both Master of Science and Doctoral degrees in Intelligent Systems.
